shared_rules: Use only the observable claim packet and prior-stage output supplied here.
Do not infer that an allegation is independently established.
Represent uncertainty explicitly; abstain when the observable packet does not support a choice.
Request a document only when it can support an active fact needed by a decision.
For every reported concept and branch predicate, copy the exact supporting locator object from the supplied source_registry; never invent or alter locator fields.
Use the supplied closed vocabulary exactly and return only the requested response object.

order.process_first: Complete decisions, required facts, branch conditions, and terminal outcomes before evidence capabilities or documents.
order.direct_neutral: Address every required information kind directly; no reasoning order is imposed.

representation.typed: Use the typed item-and-dependency intermediate response schema.
representation.plain_text: Use the sectioned plain-text intermediate response schema; do not create item IDs or typed links.

factorial_intermediate.objective: Analyze the observable claim using every shared information requirement. Do not produce the final CandidateArtifact in this call.

factorial_finalize.objective: Map the observable packet and prior analysis into the final CandidateArtifact.
factorial_finalize.ordering_constraint: Use the prior analysis as evidence, but apply no new reasoning-order or representation instruction.

EXIDE_V3.adaptation: Independent paper-inspired adaptation; not an exact reproduction and no external code, prompts, examples, or data are included.
EXIDE_V3.method: Independent adaptation of ExIde-P5 executable grounding and global rule-dependency ideas under the same final CandidateArtifact contract

exide_v3_intermediate.objective: Translate the observable packet into executable pseudo-code and atomic condition/action rules.
exide_v3_intermediate.ordering_constraint: Do not create CasePath fact, evidence, document, graph, or request structures in this call.

exide_v3_finalize.objective: Infer dependencies among the rules, then map the packet and rule draft into the final CandidateArtifact.
exide_v3_finalize.ordering_constraint: Preserve rule-first grounding before constructing the final representation.

document_first_v3_intermediate.objective: Derive a candidate document checklist and document states directly from the observable claim and source artifacts. Do not construct a process graph in this call.
document_first_v3_intermediate.ordering_constraint: List document hypotheses before any process, fact, or decision mapping.

document_first_v3_finalize.objective: Map the observable packet and document-first draft into the final CandidateArtifact.
document_first_v3_finalize.ordering_constraint: Preserve the document-first starting point while satisfying the identical final response contract.
